question_text: While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Soo Sunny Park is a Korean American artist who uses light as her primary medium of expression. • She created her work Unwoven Light in 2013. • Unwoven Light featured a chain-link fence fitted with iridescent plexiglass tiles. • When light passed through the fence, colorful prisms formed. The student wants to describe Unwoven Light to an audience unfamiliar with Soo Sunny Park. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

classification.classification_rationale: This question requires synthesizing discrete bullet points into a cohesive, audience-appropriate description. The correct answer integrates artist identity, work title/year, physical components, and visual effect — all necessary for an unfamiliar audience. Distractors omit critical elements or misattribute the medium.

explanation.short: Option D synthesizes all key elements — artist identity, year, medium, physical structure, and visual effect — into a coherent, audience-appropriate description.
explanation.full: Option D effectively combines the artist’s background (Korean American), the work’s title and year (Unwoven Light, 2013), the material components (chain-link fence with iridescent plexiglass tiles), and the resulting visual phenomenon (colorful prisms formed by light). This provides a complete, self-contained description suitable for an unfamiliar audience. Option A incorrectly implies that the fence and tiles are the medium, not light. Option B omits the physical structure and visual effect. Option C focuses only on one component without context or outcome.

options.label: A
options.text: Park’s 2013 installation Unwoven Light, which included a chain-link fence and iridescent tiles made from plexiglass, featured light as its primary medium of expression.
options.why_wrong: Misattributes the medium: the fence and tiles are structural components, not the medium; light is the true medium, but the phrasing implies the physical objects are the medium.
options.why_plausible: Includes correct artist, year, and materials; mentions 'light as medium' — aligns with first note.

options.label: B
options.text: Korean American light artist Soo Sunny Park created Unwoven Light in 2013.
options.why_wrong: Omits all physical description and visual effect; fails to describe what Unwoven Light actually is or does, making it inadequate for an unfamiliar audience.
options.why_plausible: Accurately states artist identity, medium, and year — core facts from notes.

options.label: C
options.text: The chain-link fence in Soo Sunny Park’s Unwoven Light was fitted with tiles made from iridescent plexiglass.
options.why_wrong: Focuses narrowly on one component without context (artist, year, medium, or visual effect); fails to convey the work’s purpose or experience.
options.why_plausible: Directly quotes third note; factually accurate about materials.

options.label: D
options.text: In Unwoven Light, a 2013 work by Korean American artist Soo Sunny Park, light formed colorful prisms as it passed through a fence Park had fitted with iridescent tiles.
options.why_plausible: Integrates artist identity, year, medium, physical structure, and visual outcome — all key elements from the notes.

question_text: Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal? While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Cecilia Vicuña is a multidisciplinary artist. • In 1971, her first solo art exhibition, Pinturas, poemas y explicaciones, was shown at the Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes in Santiago, Chile. • Her poetry collection Precario/Precarious was published in 1983 by Tanam Press. • Her poetry collection Instan was published in 2002 by Kelsey St. Press. • She lives part time in Chile, where she was born, and part time in New York.
passage_text: The student wants to introduce the artist’s 1983 poetry collection.

classification.classification_rationale: This is an Expression of Ideas question requiring synthesis of relevant facts from bulleted notes to fulfill a specific rhetorical goal (introducing a 1983 poetry collection). The correct answer must include the collection’s title, year, publisher, and author — all present in Option C. Distractors either introduce irrelevant details (A, D) or are too general (B).

explanation.short: Option C directly introduces the 1983 poetry collection with its title, publisher, and author identity — all relevant to the student's goal — without adding extraneous or off-topic details.
explanation.full: The student’s goal is to introduce the 1983 poetry collection. Option C fulfills this by naming the collection (Precario/Precarious), specifying its publication year (1983), identifying the publisher (Tanam Press), and linking it to Cecilia Vicuña as a multidisciplinary artist — all information present in the notes. Option A incorrectly implies a temporal sequence (before publishing books, she exhibited art) that isn’t required for introducing the collection. Option B is too general and doesn’t mention the 1983 collection specifically. Option D focuses on the 1971 exhibition and birthplace, which are irrelevant to introducing the 1983 poetry book. Only Option C synthesizes exactly the needed information without distraction.
